      Constructor. Delegates to Experiment(LearningAlgorithm, EquivalenceOracle, Alphabet, InputModelSerializer) using null for serializer.
      Parameters:
      learningAlgorithm - the learning algorithm to use in this experiment
      equivalenceAlgorithm - the strategy for finding counterexamples

      public Experiment(LearningAlgorithm<? extends A,I,D> learningAlgorithm, EquivalenceOracle<? super A,I,D> equivalenceAlgorithm, Alphabet<I> inputs, @Nullable InputModelSerializer<I,? super A> serializer)
      Constructor. Creates a new experiment to run.
      Parameters:
      learningAlgorithm - the learning algorithm to use in this experiment
      equivalenceAlgorithm - the strategy for finding counterexamples
      inputs - the inputs to consider for exploration
      serializer - the serializer for logging intermediate hypotheses (may be null in case no such logging is wanted)
